jobs.title: Summer Analyst - Energy and Real Assets - Structured Finance, Transportation at Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank
jobs.description: Employer: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank Expires: 11/20/2026 ABOUT CRÉDIT AGRICOLE CIBCrédit Agricole CIB is the Corporate and Investment Banking arm of the Crédit Agricole Group, the 10th largest banking group worldwide by balance sheet size (The Banker, 2025). The Bank offers clients a broad range of products and services across capital markets, investment banking, structured finance, and corporate banking.As the No. 1 retail bank in France, Crédit Agricole is the leading financial partner of the French economy and one of the largest retail banks in Europe — committed to building a world-class European leader in banking and insurance in accordance with the UN Global Compact. Summer Analyst Internship Program SummaryThe Summer Analyst Internship Program offers students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in investment banking within a high-profile department at Crédit Agricole CIB. Interns work alongside Associates, Vice Presidents, and senior bankers, receiving mentorship and real-world exposure to deal structuring, financial analysis, and portfolio management. Top performers have the opportunity to convert into full-time US Analyst roles following graduation.Divisional OverviewCrédit Agricole CIB is a worldwide leader in aircraft and rail financing, with numerous industry awards over the past 15 years. The Transportation Group within the Energy and Real Assets Division specializes in originating Capital Market solutions and creating tailor-made financing solutions for airlines, lessors, and rail companies across North and Latin America. The Intern will join a dynamic, collaborative team and contribute to a market-leading practice with an established reputation for excellence in structured finance solutions across the Americas region. RESPONSIBILITIES Transaction Origination & Execution: Support Associates, Vice Presidents, and Relationship Managers in structuring, originating, and executing sophisticated financing transactions. Gain full knowledge of the bank's systems and procedures. Run initial profitability and collateral/debt sizing analyses on new deals and assess counterparties' ratings. Financial Analysis: Support Associates in preparing credit analyses on airlines, aircraft leasing companies, and railcar leasing companies for new transactions and annual reviews. Client Materials: Support Associates, Vice Presidents, and Relationship Managers in creating compelling pitch books and client presentations to support business development. Portfolio Management: Under the supervision of the Portfolio Manager, support Associates with conducting annual reviews of existing transactions and counterparty ratings. Monitor compliance, KYC requirements, covenants, and special projects. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with credit department, back/middle office, and product groups (Loan Syndications, Interest Rate Derivatives, Securitization, Debt Capital Markets, etc.) to liaise and respond to credit questions and coordinate on transactions. Cross-Business Support: On a regular basis and depending on workload, provide support to other Energy and Real Assets Business Lines, particularly those dealing with mobile assets (Shipping and Intermodal). MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Currently enrolled student or recent graduate expected to graduate between December 2027 and June 2028 Bachelor's degree in Finance or related field Must be eligible to work in the US without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future (including but not limited to F-1, OPT, CPT, H-1B, or any other visa category) 0–1 years of professional experience in Finance or a related fieldPREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Relevant business/finance coursework in school Previous internship experience in banking or structured finance Proactive disposition with strong interpersonal skills and problem-solving mindset Strong analytical, credit, and communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office products (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) Fluency in English; Spanish is a plus Familiarity with transportation, aviation, or rail sectors

jobs.title: Property Management Intern at JLL
jobs.description: Employer: JLL Expires: 11/20/2026 About Property Management:JLL's Property Management is a comprehensive service that focuses on managing and optimizing the performance of real estate properties on behalf of owners or investors. JLL acts as a trusted advisor, helping clients maximize the value of their assets while providing exceptional tenant experiences. Through their expertise in lease administration, financial management, and maintenance coordination, JLL property managers ensure that properties are efficiently operated and deliver strong returns for their clients. By leveraging cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights, JLL enables seamless communication, streamlined operations, and informed decision-making. The property management business line at JLL presents an exciting opportunity for college students to gain valuable experience, develop diverse skills, and contribute to the success of real estate portfolios.What the job involves:We are currently seeking an Intern in Property Management join our team. In this role, you will learn the basics of property management, invoicing/payment systems, and tenant experience/support.As an Intern in Property Management at JLL, you will learn the following:Process and code all accounts payable invoices at the property per established schedules.Ensure invoices are paid on time and review all past due invoices to ensure proper payment has been made. Research and request appropriate back-up from vendor if necessary.Send out rent statements to tenants in sufficient time according to accounting calendar.Collect rent and ensure accounts receivable balances are minimized at the property.Provide lease administration services to the property to include but not limited to lease abstraction and lease file maintenance.Track and maintain Certificates of Insurance; responsible for notifying tenants and vendors of expired COI's and COI requirements via letters.Maintain spreadsheet of COI's on file that detail the insured and the policy expiration.Generating contracts for services at the property per the direction and input of the General Manager.Complete assigned financial reporting tasks in support of client requirements.Assist the General Manager in preparation of the annual asset plan and budget.Provide quality assurance on contracted vendors as requested by the General Manager.Participate in the property’s Team Emergency Response Plan and procedures.Assist in Move-In/Move-Out processes and procedures.Answer telephones and greeting visitors.Administer tenant relations programs, including tenant events.Handle any tenant issues regarding maintenance or service requests quickly, passing along urgent matter to General Manager, when appropriate.Other duties as assigned by the General Manager falling within the reasonable expectations of an administrative position at a real estate services office.Program DetailsDates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027Location: Orlando, FL Education, Skills, and ExperienceActively pursuing a bachelor’s degree, with 2-3 years completed majoring in business or related field.Interest in property managementDemonstrated ability to take initiativeComfortable with public speakingAbility to develop relationshipsAbility to problem solve and bring innovative ideas to a challengeAble to work independently, with minimal directionAbility to work well within a team environmentWe do not offer relocation assistance or housing for our internship program.Permanent US work authorization required.About our Internship ProgramTake the opportunity to start your career early in the commercial real estate field! Spend time learning what it’s like to work in the fast-paced, entrepreneurial, team-oriented environment at JLL.Interns are an important part of what makes JLL a great place to work. Within our program, interns are an integral part of our team working alongside real estate analysts, transaction professionals and other associates. You will gain valuable insight into the commercial real estate industry while being exposed to multiple lines of business over the course of your internship.

jobs.title: Online Qualitative Research Intern at C+R Research
jobs.description: Employer: C+R Research Expires: 11/20/2026 ABOUT C+R RESEARCHThere’s a reason we’ve been named one of Chicago’s Best Places to work. For over 60 years, C+R has recognized that our people are our greatest asset. Our culture is built on our employees’ curiosity, allowing everyone to grow and cultivate their passions and strengths, while at the same time, collaborating and supporting one another. We truly welcome creative thinking and input from all levels in our organization.At C+R, all analysts work directly with senior managers and owners, who are all still analysts working on projects, as well as face-to-face with clients. Our client brands are mostly Fortune 1,000 companies (both B2C and B2B) and our teams work across a variety of categories using the most innovative methodologies.POSITION FUNCTION:If you consider yourself curious about consumer behavior, like to know why people do the things they do, or even dub yourself an avid “people-watcher,” this role would be a great fit for you! C+R Research, a top-rated marketing insights agency in Chicago, is looking for a full-time, Summer, Qualitative Research Intern. The intern will support the execution of online qualitative research projects, including online communities, discussion boards, live virtual sessions, and other digital research experiences. Working alongside experienced researchers, the intern will gain exposure to all phases of the research process, from project setup through analysis and reporting. POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:Essential Duties:Learn the basics of market research, specifically online qualitative tools, and processes Learn and work with leading online qualitative and AI-enabled research platforms used to engage consumers and uncover insightsWork closely with Analysts and qualitative services team on various aspects of project.Collaborate with Analysts on project set-up, including:screener writingprofiling respondentsguide writing and programming (no coding experience required)Assist in moderation and note-taking of live activities and open forum discussions, with Analyst assistance Participate in internal brainstorming sessions, client workshops, and debriefs Contribute to analysis and reporting by generating summaries and/or gathering supporting materials Sit-in on virtual report presentations Other Duties:Stay informed about evolving research methods and industry trends.Keep up-to-date and knowledgeable about clients’ businesses, industries and/or customersSpecial projects as required SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:Exceptional organizational and communication skillsIs comfortable handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environmentAttention to detail and accuracyHands-on experience using Microsoft Office productsIs between Junior Year and Senior year academic standingIs graduating from an accredited college/university in Winter of 2027 or Spring of 2028.Is able to work for any US employer indefinitely, without sponsorship. (Not F-1 OPT eligible.)WHAT YOU’LL GAIN:Exposure to the full qualitative research process, from project setup through analysis and reportingExperience translating business questions into participant-friendly research activitiesHands-on familiarity with online qualitative research platforms and methodsOpportunities to observe client workshops, presentations, and internal strategy sessionsCoaching and collaboration with experienced qualitative researchers EDUCATION:Studying for Bachelor’s in Marketing, Marketing Research, Psychology, Sociology, Communication, or other related field. WORKING CONDITIONS:Office environment. Note: Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

jobs.title: Intern, Outreach and Community Engagement - 638043588 at WETA
jobs.description: Employer: WETA Expires: 11/20/2026 Start Date: 12/4/2026 End Date: 4/2/2027 Preferred Year in School: · Rising Senior · Graduate Student POSITION OVERVIEW: Interns in the Outreach and Community Engagement department handle a wide range of assignments, including writing, webinar tech support, event coordination, content development, data compilation, marketing, and web research — all designed to support engagement around local and national productions in the D.C metropolitan area. Interns occasionally work directly with families and children in settings such as schools, libraries, and childcare centers. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: · Collaborate with the Outreach & Engagement team to support events and educational workshops, providing onsite and virtual assistance with logistics, registration, marketing, and follow-up material distribution. · Contribute to the development of content for the monthly newsletter. · Conduct web research on assigned tasks. · Develop and maintain community databases. · Gather and process data collected from events and educational workshops using surveys, informal assessments, and anecdotal notes. EDUCATION: Preferred Major: English, Communications, Journalism, Social Work, Education LEARNING OBJECTIVES: · The process of outreach and engagement, from conceptualizing an idea to pitching it to stakeholders to executing the project. · Expand knowledge and skills to develop and strengthen partnerships with local organizations, such as neighborhood groups, special interest groups, government, libraries, etc. · A strong understanding of public media, potential careers and more specifically how local WETA differentiates itself from national WETA. DESIRED COMPETENCIES: · Excellent written and oral communication skills. · Strong organizational, computer and research skills. · Ability to work independently and as part of a team. · Ability to manage technological transitions for virtual workshops. LOCATION WETA and NewsHour Productions are Washington, DC established media and news organizations. We are a largely local workforce based out of the Campbell Place office in Arlington, VA. WETA and NewsHour Productions value employee flexibility when possible. Most positions based in our Arlington, VA office will be onsite or hybrid, depending upon the role. COMPANY OVERVIEW WETA, the flagship public media station in the nation’s capital, produces and distributes content that informs, inspires, and enriches lives. As the second-largest producing station for the public media system, WETA creates programming to explore history, arts, and culture, partnering with acclaimed filmmakers such as Ken Burns and Dr. Henry Louis Gates, Jr. National WETA productions include The American Revolution and Finding Your Roots, among many others. WETA is also home to PBS News, the primary daily, breaking, and special news producer for PBS. Its broadcast productions include PBS News Hour, Washington Week with The Atlantic, Horizons from PBS News, and Compass Points from PBS News, as well as specials, documentaries, and a robust footprint across digital platforms. Locally, WETA serves audiences across Washington, D.C., Virginia, and Maryland, through television, radio, and digital platforms. Audiences access WETA on broadcast channels WETA PBS, WETA UK, WETA Metro, WETA World, and WETA PBS Kids, and digitally through the free streaming platform WETA+. Listeners tune into WETA Classical, the exclusive home for classical music in the Greater Washington area, via radio, online, and the WETA Classical app. Benefits | WETA EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY WETA and NewsHour Productions are equal opportunity employers committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and internships. WETA and NewsHour Productions make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.description: Employer: WETA Expires: 11/20/2026 Start Date: 12/4/2026 End Date: 4/2/2027 Preferred Year in School: · Rising Senior · Graduate Student · Recent Graduate POSITION OVERVIEW: PBS News Student Reporting Labs (SRL) seeks an Academy Events Intern to support the planning, coordination and execution of SRL's academy programs for high school students, and youth media/educator-related projects. SRL Academies are intensive, multi-day video journalism production opportunities for high school students. Students are brought together in groups to develop and create original content. Students work as a team, moving through the entire journalism process; developing ideas/pitches, researching and conducting interviews, producing/fielding video/audio/photo, editing and creating a final product. In addition to working through this process, students also receive instruction and constructive feedback from SRL staff and experienced mentors. This internship is geared towards students seeking meaningful experience in events management, non-profit administration, and/or program design, and who bring an interest in youth media, journalism, education, or public broadcasting. Interns must be very organized, flexible, and able to multi-task. They should bring experience working on projects with many moving parts and complicated logistics, and be skilled at communicating progress and roadblocks frequently and clearly with a variety of collaborators. This position follows a hybrid schedule. The intern is required to work in person at WETA every Thursday. jobs.description: Employer: Doc Wealth Expires: 11/21/2026 We're building the largest physician-focused tax company in the country, growing faster than anyone in this space. jobs.title: Junior Events Coordinator / Intern at Le Basque Catering
jobs.description: Employer: Le Basque Catering Expires: 11/21/2026 About Us: Established in the 1990s, our luxury catering and production company has been the benchmark for high-end events, flawless hospitality, and bespoke design. From intimate, high-profile private dinners to grand corporate galas and multi-day productions, we handle events of all kinds and sizes with a signature commitment to refined elegance and European-rooted service standards. We pride ourselves on cultivating the next generation of hospitality leaders, providing hands-on mentorship in a fast-paced, luxury creative environment. Position Overview • Role: Junior Events Coordinator / Intern • Type: Hourly Internship / Part-time Contract • Duration: Approx. 3–4 months (Spanning our peak busy season, starting in November 2026). There is the potential to be hired full-time or have an internship extension.• Compensation: $15.00 / hour • Location: Miami, FL (Office prep and varying on-site event venues) • Target Audience: Passionate undergraduate students currently enrolled in a School of Hospitality & Tourism Management (or related program) seeking real-world luxury experience. Job Summary As a Junior Events Coordinator / Intern, you will work directly alongside our experienced Coordinators and Senior Producers during our most exciting and busiest time of the year. This role bridges the gap between the classroom and the elite event industry, offering a 360-degree view of what it takes to execute flawless luxury productions. You will assist with meticulous pre-event planning in the office and provide vital operational support on-site during live events. Core Responsibilities Pre-Event Preparation & Office Support: • Assist senior coordinators with event logistics, vendor sourcing, and organizing production timelines. • Help maintain and organize event inventory, design elements, and styling materials. • Review event orders, floor plans, and production notes to ensure total accuracy ahead of load-in. • Provide general administrative support to ensure the coordination team is fully equipped for upcoming events. On-Site Event Execution: • Assist with on-site setup, including managing timelines, spatial layout oversight, and meticulous aesthetic detailing. • Act as a reliable point of contact for coordinators, vendors, and service staff during live execution. • Help manage guest flow, registration, or specific activation zones depending on the scale of the event. • Assist with post-event strike and breakdown, ensuring all company assets are safely accounted for. Qualifications & Requirements We are looking for passionate, high-energy individuals who are eager to learn the art of old-school luxury hospitality. • Education: Currently pursuing an undergraduate or master's degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, or a related field. • The Luxury Mindset: An innate eye for detail, a polished professional presentation, and a deep appreciation for high-end aesthetics and formal service standards. • Adaptability & Stamina: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Events require long hours on your feet, moving quickly, and adapting to real-time changes. • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact professionally with high-net-worth clients, vendors, and internal teams. • Schedule Flexibility: Must be available to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, aligned with our peak winter event calendar. • Transportation: Reliable transportation to get to our main office and various luxury event venues across the greater Miami area. What You Will Gain • Direct, resume-building experience with a pioneer in Miami’s luxury event industry. • Mentorship from seasoned industry professionals who understand the nuances of high-end catering and production. • Networking opportunities within the elite tiers of South Florida’s hospitality scene. • Flexible hourly scheduling that can work around your final exams and winter course load. To Apply: Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter detailing your career goals in luxury hospitality and your availability for the winter season. Immediate positions are open for our upcoming peak period!

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Internship Program - Information Security Intern at Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta
jobs.description: Employer: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Expires: 11/21/2026 As an employee of the Atlanta Fed, you will help support our mission of promoting the stability and efficiency of the U.S. economy and financial system. Your work will affect the economy of the Southeast, the United States, and the world. The work we do here is important, and how we do it is just as important as what we do. We live our values of integrity, excellence, and respect every day. We do the right thing, we do things right, and we treat people right. A career at the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta gives you the chance to do work that touches lives and helps communities prosper. The Bank believes in flexibility to balance the demands of work and life while also recognizing the necessity of connecting and collaborating with our colleagues in person. Onsite work is an essential function of this position, and you are required to be onsite according to the schedule set by your management. OUR BANK - The Federal Reserve is the central bank of the United States and is one of the most influential, trusted, and prestigious financial organizations. It consists of twelve Reserve Banks located around the country and the Board of Governors in Washington, D.C. The Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta territory covers the Sixth Federal Reserve District, which includes Alabama, Florida, and Georgia, and portions of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee. The Atlanta Fed and the other Reserve Banks play an important part in all three of the Fed's functions: monetary policy, bank supervision and regulation, and the operation of a nationwide payment system. PLEASE READ: Internships are paid. Summer housing will not be provided. This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, performance standards or requirements, efforts, skills or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g. emergencies, rush jobs, change in workload or technological developments). SCOPE OF ASSIGNMENT: This role will support the local Information Security function in delivering District-specific security services that complement centralized enterprise security programs. This role provides exposure to the unique responsibilities of District-level security work, including local incident coordination, threat monitoring, risk assurance, and stakeholder engagement — all performed in close partnership with central security teams while addressing needs specific to this Reserve Bank location. QUALIFICATIONS: Networking Knowledge: Understand TCP/IP, DNS, routing, and firewalls to see how data moves and where vulnerabilities hide.Operating Systems: Know your way around both Windows and Linux command lines, file structures, and user permissions.Security Principles: Grasp core ideas like the CIA triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability), threat analysis, and basic risk management.Basic Scripting: Write simple scripts in Python or PowerShell to automate tasks and analyze data quickly. PREFERRED MAJORS: Computer ScienceCybersecurityRisk ManagementComputer Information Systems CORE COMPETENCIES: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) Strong analytical skills Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects Great work ethic and detail oriented Comfortable working across time zones to complete projects in a timely manner OUR BENEFITS TO INTERNS (some benefits are subject to being onsite): Professional development opportunities Networking MARTA passes provided Free LinkedIn Learning access Free access to our FedFuel career development tool Café and dining options on-site Dress for your day Flexible hours Access to on-site fitness center TO APPLY: In addition to your application, please attach a resume and a copy of your most recent unofficial transcript. Additional Requirements: This position will require at minimum fingerprinting for a criminal background check, education and employment verification, along with potential additional screening requirements due to the information accessed while performing the job. Any offer of employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of any required background screening. These screenings would be initiated at the time of offer acceptance and can take up to approximately 8 weeks to be completed. The screening covers areas such as education/employment verification, criminal history, credit history, and reaches out to your references and people that know you well. For Law Enforcement positions, physical, psychological, drug, stress/EKG, and attending an academy will be required. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta employees must comply with the Bank’s ethics rules. These rules generally prohibit employees, their spouses/domestic partners, and minor children from holding financial interests (such as common stock and corporate bonds) issued by financial institutions. This prohibition also applies to investment funds that focus on investing in the financial sector. If you, your spouse/domestic partner, or minor child own such securities, you will generally be asked to divest them if you accept an offer of Bank employment. If you have concerns about this prohibition, you should raise the issue with the recruiter for this posting early in the process. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g. emergencies, rush jobs, change in workload or technological developments). The Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description: Employer: Novogradac & Company LLP Expires: 11/21/2026 Dare to bring your unique perspective?At Novogradac, we value individuals who bring unique perspectives and bold ideas. If you’re eager to contribute to an inclusive, innovative environment where your personal and professional growth is encouraged and supported, we invite you to explore this exciting opportunity with us. Novogradac is hiring Staff Accountant Interns to explore our firm for busy season 2027 (January 2027 through the end of March 2027). Our trendsetting interns learn hands-on what it takes to be a staff accountant for a growing national CPA firm by tackling a variety of different assignments, including audit, tax preparation and research. jobs.description: Employer: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank Expires: 11/21/2026 ABOUT CRÉDIT AGRICOLE CIBCrédit Agricole CIB is the Corporate and Investment Banking arm of the Crédit Agricole Group, the 10th largest banking group worldwide by balance sheet size (The Banker, 2022). The Bank offers clients a broad range of products and services across capital markets, investment banking, structured finance, and corporate banking.As the No. 1 retail bank in France, Crédit Agricole is the leading financial partner of the French economy and one of the largest retail banks in Europe — committed to building a world-class European leader in banking and insurance in accordance with the UN Global Compact. Summer Analyst Internship Program SummaryThe Summer Analyst Internship Program offers students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in investment banking within a high-profile department at Crédit Agricole CIB. Interns work alongside senior bankers, receiving mentorship and real-world exposure to credit analysis, deal structuring, and portfolio management. Top performers have the opportunity to convert into full-time US Analyst roles following graduation. Divisional OverviewCrédit Agricole CIB's Real Estate, Lodging & Gaming Group specializes in structured finance transactions across the commercial real estate, hospitality, and gaming sectors. The Intern will support the Structured Finance team in credit analysis, documentation review, and administration of credit exposures across single asset financings, portfolio financings, corporate financings, and structured derivatives. This role offers exposure to complex deal structures and hands-on learning in credit risk management. RESPONSIBILITIES • Assist in preparing credit applications and related materials for credit risk approval, including amendment and waiver requests • Conduct industry analysis and competitive analysis; assess relevant risk factors for transactions under consideration • Build and review financial models using Argus and internal modeling tools under senior guidance • Analyze and condense historical, financial, and other information on clients, including cash flow projections • Support monitoring of credit exposures and preparation of Annual Reviews and other credit reports as needed • Assist in reviewing legal documentation with the legal department and obtaining credit approval for legal documentation • Participate in client visits and bank meetings • Support ongoing review of portfolio names regarding operating performance, borrowing base, and covenant compliance • Coordinate with various Bank departments on matters concerning account servicing and credit authorizations MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS • Currently enrolled student or recent graduate expected to graduate between December 2027 and June 2028 • BA or BS degree in Finance or related field • Must be eligible to work in the US without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future (including but not limited to F-1, OPT, CPT, H-1B, or any other visa category) • 0–1 years of professional experience in Finance or a related field PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Financial modeling skills (Excel, Argus) • Strong written communication skills • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills • Experience or familiarity with Real Estate or Hotel industry • Strong team-player mentality with ability to work under pressure • Prior internship or banking experience

jobs.title: 2027 Investor Operations Summer Internship at Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH)
jobs.description: Employer: Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) Expires: 11/21/2026 2027 Investor Operations InternshipNew Jersey At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership - it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career. We’re looking for sharp minds and bold thinkers to join our internship program - your pathway to real-world operations, transformation, and technology that drive global banking, and the kind of professional development that sets you apart. We value our internship programs as they help us identify our future hires and leaders. What You’ll Experience in BBH’s Internship Program:Overview: Experience a dynamic 10-week internship where you will be fully immersed in BBH’s culture and business needs.Hands-On Learning: Dive into meaningful projects supporting Investor Services Service Delivery division across operations and global client service.Mentorship That Matters: Work side by side with industry leaders who are invested in your growth.Professional Development: Sharpen your skills through workshops, speaker series, and networking events designed to accelerate your career. Receive continuous and personalized feedback throughout the program, empowering you to grow, refine your skills, and navigate your path to success.Collaborative Environment: Join a tight-knit team where your ideas are heard, your contributions matter, and your potential is unleashed.On-Site Presence: Immerse yourself in our company culture and accelerate your professional development with daily in-office presence.Community: Make a positive impact by volunteering in our philanthropic program, BBHcares, while connecting with fellow BBHers. Ever wonder what happens behind the scenes as a financial transaction moves around the world? BBH Service Delivery is the operational engine behind the banking. An internship within Service Delivery provides a unique perspective on how BBH delivers service excellence to our global clients and across the organization. If you’re passionate about learning the different areas of the banking business, leading transformation, leveraging data and technology, and driving business outcomes for a global organization, Service Delivery is the place for you. What you can expect from a BBH Service Delivery Internship:Join a dynamic team at the heart of global operations, partnering with business leaders to deliver insights and information to support internal stakeholders and clients.Gain hands-on experience managing high-volume financial transactions with accuracy, efficiency, and a strong commitment to meeting critical deadlines.Put your analytical and problem-solving skills to work by investigating discrepancies, identifying root causes, and escalating findings when appropriate.Build relationships across the business by communicating clearly and confidently with internal and external clients and counterparties to resolve issues and help minimize riskLearn what exceptional client service looks like in practice and contribute to the high-quality experience BBH delivers to clients around the world.Take on specialized projects where you will work with large data sets, uncover meaningful insights, and help inform operational decisions.Exposure to leading edge financial services technology including Generative AI tools.Share ideas to improve operational efficiency and individual productivity, contribute to department and BBH process improvement activities.Collaborate with fellow interns on a high-visibility team project and present your recommendations to senior leaders. Areas of focus may include:Fund Accounting – processing activities within funds, compiling reporting, assisting with NAV process, Alternatives / Private Markets operationsCustody Operations – processing client instructions, document validation, verifying and validating transactions, participating in client callsGlobal Client Service – Participating in client meetings, handling inquiries, compiling reportingTransformation Management – automating processes for operational teams, compiling data, assisting with project-based documents What Service Delivery Operations looks for in an Intern:Current junior in college, entering senior year in Fall 2027, with a background in and passion for Business, Innovation and Design, or Project Management. Strong academic achievement as evidenced by a GPA of 3.3 or higher. Demonstrated leadership skills through academic and extracurricular activities. Outstanding communication skills, written and verbal; ability to explain technical issues in simple terms. Demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically, both independently and as part of a team. Sound judgment and demonstrated ability to identify, escalate, and resolve problems. Ability to prioritize competing demands and manage multiple deadlines. Ability to analyze business processes to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement. Experience or interest in working with large quantities of information for analysis. Intermediate proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint - comfortable using common formulas (e.g., VLOOKUP, IF), building basic charts, and creating/manipulating pivot tables for simple analysis. Passion and intellectual curiosity for learning, and the use of generative AI tools. Ready to Apply? Applications for BBH’s 2027 Internship Program close October 28th, 2026. Don’t miss your chance to work alongside industry leaders, gain hands-on experience, and immerse yourself in a culture of excellence. Apply early to secure your spot and start building your future with BBH. Candidates should submit applications for a maximum of two positions. Applications should be targeted to the roles that most closely align with the candidate's background and interests. We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, included alternative experiences, or if it doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.About BBH:Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us. We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development - so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice - creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another. We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often - pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours. Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, genetic information, creed, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under federal, state or local law.

jobs.description: Employer: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank Expires: 11/21/2026 ABOUT CRÉDIT AGRICOLE CIBCrédit Agricole CIB is the Corporate and Investment Banking arm of the Crédit Agricole Group, the 10th largest banking group worldwide by balance sheet size (The Banker, 2022). The Bank offers clients a broad range of products and services across capital markets, investment banking, structured finance, and corporate banking.As the No. 1 retail bank in France, Crédit Agricole is the leading financial partner of the French economy and one of the largest retail banks in Europe — committed to building a world-class European leader in banking and insurance in accordance with the UN Global Compact. US Analyst Internship Program SummaryThe Summer Analyst Internship Program offers students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in investment banking within a high-profile department at Crédit Agricole CIB. Interns work alongside experienced professionals, receiving mentorship and real-world exposure to deal origination, portfolio management, and credit analysis. Top performers have the opportunity to convert into full-time US Analyst roles following graduation. Divisional OverviewCrédit Agricole CIB's Energy & Infrastructure Group (EIG) Latin America team sources and manages complex project financings across the Latin American energy and infrastructure sectors. Based in New York, the team focuses on originating new business while managing an active portfolio of existing loans. The Intern will support senior team members in pitching for business, processing credit applications, closing financings, and managing portfolio transactions in coordination with the Portfolio Manager. RESPONSIBILITIES• Support the Group's efforts in managing the portfolio of existing project finance loans to energy and infrastructure projects across Latin America, including performing annual reviews and preparing material for approval of waivers and amendments • Assist the Group Head and Portfolio Manager on periodic reporting to Head Office • Support monitoring of Know-Your-Customer reviews of clients in the portfolio • Build and review financial models based on contract terms and economic assumptions under senior guidance • Develop and improve skills in financial modeling through hands-on assignments • Assist in preparing proposals to clients, identifying project specifics, indicative terms, CACIB credentials, and team organization • Participate in preparation and execution of pitches to clients in coordination with relationship managers • Support preparation of business opportunity memoranda and credit applications, including transaction descriptions, key features, and risk analysis • Complete internal worksheets and applications (rating grid, environmental screening, profitability calculation, KYC forms, and compliance items) MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS • Currently enrolled student or recent graduate expected to graduate between December 2027 and June 2028 • Must be eligible to work in the US without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future (including but not limited to F-1, OPT, CPT, H-1B, or any other visa category) • 0–1 years of professional experience in Finance or a related field PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Degree in Finance, Economics, or related field • Prior experience building and reviewing financial models • Familiarity with energy and infrastructure projects • Excellent written and oral communication skills • Proficiency in Spanish • Prior internship or banking experience

jobs.title: Financial Advisor Intern at Baystate Financial
jobs.description: Employer: Baystate Financial Expires: 11/21/2026 BEGIN YOUR FINANCIAL CAREER WITH AN INTERNSHIP WITH BAYSTATE FINANCIAL **We are currently interviewing for our Summer 2027 internship class in all of our New England offices** The first step in our interview process is to join a group information session via Zoom to learn more about Baystate Financial, the career of an advisor, and the industry in general. Our next information session is scheduled for Thursday November 19th at 11am . Please use the following link to register:https://financialguide.zoom.us/meeting/register/13bbpaTVTdaqteUivYdCFQ In addition, please complete the Culture Index Survey listed below:https://go.cultureindex.com/p/3Cs6YkulwTG1 Baystate Financial is selecting full-time college students for our hands-on internship program. We are seeking highly motivated, entrepreneurial students, interested in a career in finance. Selected candidates will be given the opportunity to get fully licensed as a financial advisor, receive top-notch training and mentorship, and gain valuable professional experience transferable to any industry. Interns that prove to be an asset to the firm will be offered a full-time position upon graduating. About This Internship Right from the beginning students are given the resources needed to help clients achieve financial security. Financial Advisor Interns are taught how to build a financial services practice from the ground up. With the help of senior advisors and the Baystate team, students will meet with clients to learn more about their individual definition of financial security and develop a “financial roadmap” to get them from where they are currently, to where they want to be. At the end of the internship, successful interns will be able to exhibit: An Understanding of How to Create and Implement a Personal Financial Plan Client Acquisition and Marketing Strategies The Role of a Full Time Financial Advisor Exceptional Listening and Problem-Solving Skills The Ability to Work Well in Both a Team and Individual Capacity Candidate Characteristics Although there are a wide variety of college majors, personal backgrounds, and life experiences that will see success in this role, there are a few characteristics we see exhibited in the majority of our most successful interns: Strong Desire to Help People, Including Individuals, Families, and Small Businesses Motivated to Work in a Client Facing/ Sales/ Finance Role Competitive, with an Entrepreneurial Spirit and a Vision to Build and Grow Their Own Business High Standards or Integrity, Empathy, Competency, Work Ethic, and Professionalism “Interested individuals are invited to apply. And, while we appreciate every applicant's interest, only those under consideration will be contacted.” About Baystate Financial Since its founding in 1901, Baystate Financial has provided comprehensive financial services, life and disability insurance, estate planning, business succession planning, retirement funding, education funding strategies, and investment management to a diverse client base. More than a century of providing guidance, insight, and results has made Baystate Financial one of the oldest and largest wealth management firms in the northeast, with 12 offices in 6 New England States. Baystate Financial is comprised of a team of over 300 advisors and over 400 support staff, many of whom contribute to building financial plans for a wide variety of individuals and businesses. Baystate Financials’ strategy is tailored to help fulfill their client’s individual goals, with the understanding that every client’s goals are different.

jobs.description: Employer: Vitablabla Expires: 11/21/2026 Job title: Marketing Intern — Social Media & TikTok Content Job type: Internship (part-time) Work setting: Remote (U.S. only) Compensation: $20/hour + 5% commission on sales generated by your videos — 1099 independent contractor. The role begins with a paid working interview: 8 videos × $30 ($240 total stipend with free sample). Hours: ~10–25 hrs/week, flexible around class schedules About UsOHCRISP is a growing U.S. snack brand making seriously crunchy freeze-dried fruit snacks. We're looking for a marketing intern who wants real, hands-on social media experience — not coffee runs and shadowing calls. You'll create TikTok content for a real consumer brand, see exactly how your videos perform, and learn how creator-led commerce (TikTok Shop) works from the inside. Our interview process — two steps, no busywork Step 1: A 30-minute video chat. A quick hello — we get a feel for your personality and on-camera presence, and you can ask us anything. No trick questions, no case studies. Step 2: A paid working trial. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Intern - Technical AI & Automation at Eulerity
jobs.description: Employer: Eulerity Expires: 11/21/2026 Eulerity is an AI-native marketing automation platform. Our software runs paid advertising, social, listings, reputation, and call tracking for thousands of locations across enterprise franchises and SMB networks, executing autonomously across Google, Meta, Apple, and Microsoft. The Technical Operations team is the analytical engine that keeps that execution sharp.We are hiring an intern to sit with this team for the summer.Who we are looking forThis is not just a marketing internship. We are looking for someone who is genuinely analytical. The kind of person who opens a messy dataset and gets curious instead of overwhelmed. Who enjoys figuring out why a number moved. Who can read a chunk of SQL or Python and follow what it does, even if they would not write it from scratch. Who would otherwise be heading toward an analyst seat at a consulting firm or a product role at a startup.If you love spreadsheets, you will feel at home here. If you have ever built a model in Excel just to understand something better, even more so.What you will actually doYou will work directly with our Technical Account Management and Analytics teams on the parts of campaign management that require thinking, not clicking. That includes:Diagnosing why specific campaigns are underperforming and proposing fixes grounded in the data.Building and refining Excel and Sheets models that our account teams use to make decisions.Auditing campaigns at scale, often across hundreds of locations for a single brand, and surfacing patterns no one else has noticed.Pulling, cleaning, and analyzing performance data from Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and our internal platform.Helping operationalize new analytical workflows, including ones we are building on top of AI tooling.Contributing to internal projects that make our team faster and smarter.You will not be writing ad copy or designing creative. You will be doing the analytical work that makes the campaigns actually perform.What we want from youCurrent student or recent graduate, ideally with coursework in something quantitative. Economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, math, finance, or similar. A traditional marketing background is not what we are looking for here.Strong Excel chops. Comfort with pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic, and building models from scratch.Basic code literacy. You do not need to be a programmer, but you should be able to read SQL, Python, or JavaScript and roughly understand what it is doing.Comfort with AI tools as a daily part of how you work. We expect everyone here to use them aggressively and intelligently, and you should be the kind of person who already does.Sharp written communication. You can take a messy analysis and explain the takeaway in three sentences.Detail-oriented and self-directed. You catch things other people miss and you do not need to be told twice.LogisticsOctober start with potential to extend based on performance.Hybrid out of our NYC office, 2 to 3 days per week in person.Minimum 20 hours per week, flexible schedule.$18 to $20 per hour.Lunch credits and unlimited snacks when in-office.Direct mentorship from senior operators on our team.******************************************************************************IMPORTANT 🛑PLEASE FILL THIS FORM TO COMPLETE YOUR APPLICATION ******************************************************************************

jobs.description: Employer: University of Iowa Center for Advancement Expires: 11/21/2026 The University of Iowa Center for Advancement (UICA) is currently providing opportunities for full-time paid summer internships. UICA encourages students from all backgrounds to explore careers in nonprofit settings, promote engagement with the University of Iowa, support and advance the university and its programs through meaningful pre-professional opportunities, and support potential graduates to obtain roles within our organization. The UICA will provide 9 intern opportunities that provide 10 weeks of work experience, June 1 - August 6. Internships are open to students entering their second year of college in Fall 2027 through students graduating from any college or university in 2027. Interns will earn $18/hour and will be provided with the flexibility and technology to work from home two days per week if desired. Up to five unpaid vacation days will be available throughout the internship program if desired. At the conclusion of the internship, all interns are expected to give a final presentation highlighting their experience and projects they have worked on. Housing and benefits are not available as part of the intern experience, and interns must be within driving distance of our Iowa City, IA office. As the UI Stanley Museum of Art Development Intern, you will support fundraising and donor engagement efforts that advance the mission and priorities of the UI Stanley Museum of Art. Working alongside the Director of Development and Program Coordinator, you will contribute to annual, special, and major gift fundraising initiatives while helping strengthen donor relationships and expand philanthropic support for the museum. This internship will provide hands-on experience in donor engagement, prospect development, stewardship, museum membership, and major gift fundraising, including exposure to gifts of artwork. Through meaningful projects and collaboration with advancement and museum professionals, you will gain valuable insight into how fundraising supports arts organizations and creates opportunities for donor connection and impact. Core Responsibilities Gain exposure to the major gift fundraising process by assisting with prospect research, meeting preparation, and meeting follow-up. Support long-term fundraising pipeline development by identifying and researching prospective annual, special, and major gift donors, including individuals interested in donating artwork. Assist in assessing and refining the museum's membership program by conducting research, analyzing engagement opportunities, and providing recommendations for future growth. Support planning efforts for the museum's forthcoming Collector's Circle membership tier, including research, benchmarking, and donor engagement strategies. Develop recommendations for three to five arts-enriched donor engagement experiences that could be implemented over the next one to two years to strengthen donor relationships and support fundraising goals. Conduct research to create a matrix of prospective institutional supporters for the UI Stanley Museum of Art with a focus on arts foundations and lending collections. Assist with stewardship communications, including donor letters, impact-focused messaging, ThankView content, and recognition efforts for artwork donors and other museum supporters. Analyze Voice of Customer (VOC) feedback and other data sources to identify key insights and opportunities. Learn how customer and market insights are used to shape busness and marketing strategies. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with teams across product management, sales, channel marketing, and corporate marketing Gain exposure to how strategy is developed and translated into product launches, marketing campaigns, and commercial execution. Coordinate with internal subject matter experts to validate research findings and assumptions. jobs.description: Employer: PrimeCare Orthotics Expires: 11/21/2026 Job Title: Healthcare Administration & Clinical Observation InternCompany: PrimeCare Orthotics & ProstheticsLocation: Las Cruces, New MexicoEmployment Type: InternshipSchedule: To be determinedJob DescriptionPrimeCare Orthotics & Prosthetics is seeking a motivated, compassionate, and detail-oriented Healthcare Administration & Clinical Observation Intern to support our administrative team and gain valuable exposure to patient care in an orthotics and prosthetics practice.This internship provides hands-on experience in medical office operations, patient scheduling, intake and medical history collection, documentation coordination, and supervised clinical observation. It is ideal for college students pursuing careers in medicine, nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, physician assistant studies, healthcare administration, or related healthcare fields.Key ResponsibilitiesAssist with scheduling patient appointments, confirming visits, and coordinating follow-ups.Contact patients regarding appointment reminders, scheduling changes, and outstanding information.Welcome patients and assist with check-in and intake paperwork.Help collect patient-reported medical histories, functional concerns, mobility limitations, and treatment goals.Identify missing information and communicate documentation needs to the appropriate team member.Assist with tracking outstanding medical records, referrals, prescriptions, and other required documentation.Organize patient paperwork and support electronic medical record administration within authorized access limits.Assist with administrative follow-ups and communication between patients, staff, and healthcare providers.Spend approximately one hour per day observing clinical evaluations, consultations, fittings, and deliveries when scheduling permits and patients consent.Learn about orthotic and prosthetic devices, patient education, mobility support, and interdisciplinary healthcare coordination.Maintain patient confidentiality and follow applicable HIPAA requirements and office policies.QualificationsCurrently enrolled in college or pursuing an interest in a healthcare-related career.Strong verbal and written communication skills.Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.Professional, dependable, compassionate, and eager to learn.Basic computer skills and willingness to learn healthcare office systems.Ability to respect patient privacy and maintain confidentiality.Bilingual English/Spanish skills are a plus.Previous healthcare experience is preferred but not required.Learning OpportunitiesInterns will develop practical skills in medical office administration, patient communication, appointment coordination, medical terminology, documentation workflows, and patient-centered care. Supervised clinical observation will provide additional insight into orthotics and prosthetics and the roles of healthcare professionals in supporting patient mobility and function.Supervision and Patient SafetyInterns will work under designated staff supervision. Clinical observation requires patient consent and appropriate privacy safeguards. Clinical decisions and procedures remain the responsibility of qualified healthcare professionals.

jobs.description: Employer: Novogradac & Company LLP Expires: 11/21/2026 Dare to bring your unique perspective?At Novogradac, we value individuals who bring unique perspectives and bold ideas. If you’re eager to contribute to an inclusive, innovative environment where your personal and professional growth is encouraged and supported, we invite you to explore this exciting opportunity with us. Our trendsetting interns learn hands-on what it takes to be a staff accountant for a growing national CPA firm by tackling a variety of different assignments, including audit, tax preparation and research. Novogradac believes in giving our interns a real-life business experience and compensating you well while you’re here. Some positions at Novogradac may be open to remote or hybrid work arrangements depending on business needs. Please discuss available options with your recruiter.Your Contributions and ResponsibilitiesComplete tax and/or audit engagements for designated clients as directed by your Supervisor or ManagerIdentify and communicate potential problem areas during engagementsConduct business-specific research – gather and analyze data, interpret results, compile reports and make recommendations to principals and partnersDevelop effective client relationships through professionalism and follow-throughOther duties and projects as assignedYour Background and SkillsWorking toward a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in accounting or finance (obtained degree is a plus), and/or appropriate balance of education and work experienceGPA of 3.20 or higherPreferred completion of at least one Intermediate Accounting course and preferably on track or already qualified to sit for the CPA examinationGraduate by December 2026 or be available to commit to a full-time internship from January through March 2027 with no classes during that periodExhibit a basic understanding of accounting and tax rulesExcellent verbal and written communication skillsPerform work accurately and in a time-efficient manner with strong attention to detail, organization and follow-throughAbility to work under close supervision and accept constructive feedback, making adjustments as directedAbility to work collaboratively and foster a productive, team-oriented environment with both colleagues and clientsStrong computer skills, including solid skill in the Microsoft Office suite (particularly Word & Excel) and report writing toolsWhy work with us?Novogradac is committed to fostering a welcoming workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to grow. We believe in offering a supportive, balanced work environment that encourages professional growth and work-life integration.We are proud to offer:Competitive salaries with continuous review of market conditionsFlexible working hours and work arrangementsRemote and hybrid opportunitiesInclusive workplace, providing strong professional growth and development opportunitiesThe benefits of joining our teamStrong growth opportunitiesStrong emphasis on quality work-life integrationDress for your day policyResources of a national firmOpportunities to engage with our active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), affinity groups, and advance your career within a supportive, inclusive environmentCompensation: $32/hrDon’t Meet Every Single Qualification?After reviewing this job posting, are you hesitating to apply because you don’t meet all the listed requirements? At Novogradac, we are dedicated to building a workplace supported by unique perspectives and experiences, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply.You may still be the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.Get to know us better!We’re Novogradac, a national certified public accounting and consulting firm headquartered in San Francisco.
